title: Signal: Possible a .pgpass credential line in source
scope: One line, matching a .pgpass credential line.
limitations: Shape-only: the rule recognises one file format and one credential position inside it. It cannot prove the value is live and it does not parse the surrounding document.

examples.line: # .pgpass lines are written at deploy time

fpNotes: Template files and documentation that use the same format with placeholder bodies are the common false positives; the pattern requires a shaped value and vetoes EXAMPLE text.
